provenance.description: Independent desktop-sounds alpha. Reads original DND, lock, and idle state; owns no notification service or UI.
provenance.referenceImplementation: Omarchy shell plugin conventions and gobijan.ui-sounds desktop-event filters; no notification implementation retained.

integrationFields.safetyReady: conservative presence and valid known fields of DND/lock/idle services + unlocked/nonidle/nonDND + real screen + settled startup
integrationFields.overlapBlocked: pluginRegistry.isEnabled('gobijan.ui-sounds') === true; unknown registry or unknown state => blocked

verification.status: Alpha implemented and exercised in the installed Omarchy shell.
sourceGates: qmllint -I /usr/lib/qt6/qml -W 0: all product QML/JS and service-safety.qml passed
runtime: Real window open/close and workspace round trip started their mapped pw-play assets; repeated workspace request produced no player.
Same-tick preview burst accepted one request and rejected two as busy.
Live mute and DND suppressed playback; DND and repeated mute cancelled a running preview.
Isolated real-QML harness passed lock/idle, missing services, service-map replacement, and overlap gating.
Invalid settings reload preserved mute and volume; settings survived plugin unload/re-enable and actual file hot reload.
Owned audio process disappeared after unload/hot reload; no startup playback.
Original notification bus owner and IPC remained unchanged; DND restored; unrelated shell configuration preserved.
verification.limitations: Physical audibility was not independently confirmed. Lock/idle transitions were simulated in the real-QML harness rather than locking the user's desktop. Notification/agent sounds and a bar widget are not part of this alpha.
